home.title: Explainable AI for brain MRI analysis
home.subtitle: Answer a short symptom questionnaire, upload an MRI scan and receive a CNN-based result with a Grad-CAM explanation, a downloadable report and suggested specialists — always reviewed by a human.
home.step1Desc: A short, transparent questionnaire gives a symptom indicator.
home.step2Desc: Secure upload with file type, size and integrity checks.
home.step3Desc: The model predicts a class and highlights the regions that influenced it.
home.step4Desc: A draft report you can review, edit and download as PDF.
home.step5Desc: General next steps and specialists to consult.
home.f1Desc: Every prediction comes with a Grad-CAM heatmap and confidence score.
home.f2Desc: AI-generated drafts always need professional review before approval.
home.f3Desc: Role-based access, validated uploads and an audit trail.
home.f4Desc: Use the app in English, Hindi or Marathi.
home.disclaimer: This system is a research and educational decision-support tool. It does not provide a medical diagnosis, and the Grad-CAM heatmap is not a confirmed tumor boundary. Always consult a qualified doctor.
home.footer: College project · Research & educational use only

auth.sideTitle: See the reasoning behind every result
auth.sideText: Grad-CAM shows where the model looked in the scan.

assess.title: Symptom questionnaire
assess.intro: Step 1 of 3 — Tell us about the symptoms experienced. This gives a simple, rule-based symptom indicator. It is not a diagnosis and has not been clinically validated.
assess.patientRefHint: Use an ID or code — please do not enter names.
assess.required: Please enter a patient reference ID.

q.headache_morning: Headaches that are worse in the morning or when lying down
q.vision: Blurred or double vision, or loss of vision
q.weakness: Weakness or numbness on one side of the body
q.balance: Loss of balance or difficulty walking
q.mood: Unusual changes in mood or personality
q.hearing: Hearing loss or ringing in the ears
q.persistent: These symptoms have lasted more than 2 weeks

scan.title: Upload MRI scan
scan.choose: Click to select an MRI image (JPEG or PNG, max 10 MB)
scan.badType: Only JPEG or PNG images are supported.
scan.noFile: Please select an MRI image first.

result.title: Result & analysis
result.placeholderWarning: The model is an untrained demo placeholder. This result has no clinical meaning.
result.disclaimer: The highlighted region shows areas that contributed to the model's prediction. It is not a confirmed tumor boundary or medical diagnosis.
result.analysisHigh: The model assigned {{pct}}% probability to “{{cls}}”, a high confidence for this model. A high score still does not confirm a finding.
result.analysisModerate: The model assigned {{pct}}% probability to “{{cls}}”, a moderate confidence. Treat the result with caution and seek review.
result.analysisLow: The model assigned only {{pct}}% probability to “{{cls}}”. Confidence is low, so this result is uncertain.
result.attention: The Grad-CAM heatmap shows where the model looked most when making this prediction (warm colours = higher influence).
result.noAssessment: No symptom questionnaire was completed for this case.
result.reportHelp: Generate an AI draft, edit it, then approve it after review.
result.doctorsNote: These are sample entries for demonstration. Replace them with verified doctors before real use.
result.lowConfidenceBanner: Low confidence — this result is uncertain. Do not rely on it without expert review.

guidance.consult_specialist: Share these results with a qualified neurologist or neurosurgeon for professional evaluation.
guidance.bring_scan: Bring the original MRI scans and reports (not only this summary) to your appointment.
guidance.low_confidence: The model's confidence is below 70%; treat this result as especially uncertain and ask for a second review.
guidance.placeholder: This result comes from an untrained demo model and has no clinical meaning.
guidance.symptoms_urgent: Warning-sign symptoms were reported (e.g. seizures, weakness, speech or vision changes). Seek prompt medical attention rather than waiting for a routine appointment.
guidance.symptoms_high: The symptom indicator is high; discuss the symptoms with a doctor soon.
guidance.no_tumor_but_symptoms: The model did not flag a tumor class, but a model result does not rule out other conditions. If symptoms persist, see a doctor.
guidance.not_diagnosis: This tool is for research and education and does not provide a diagnosis.
